findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "send_feedback" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Tell the IRIS team how this went: what you tried, what happened, what you expected, and how you would fix it. Use it after any call that failed, returned someth…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_launches, get_voices, get_jobs · Private data: get_market, send_feedback · Public sink: get_jobs, send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_launches, get_voices, get_jobs · Private data: get_market, send_feedback · Public sink: get_jobs, send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
